title: An AI Research Agent That Runs Your Experiments — Tim Sweeney, Weights & Biases
talk_summary: Tim Sweeney demos Arya, a W&B research agent that runs long training experiments via a launch queue and sandbox, and then explains how they build it: a worker harness with sandbox, LLM provider, long-running job queue, and full trace observability. The transferable core is their offline improvement loop: 100% trace logging, YAML 'tasks' as unit tests for the agent scored by LLM and rule-based judges, a nightly eval suite, and human review of best/worst traces.

takeaways.technique: YAML task files as agent unit tests with mixed LLM + rule judges
takeaways.what_they_do: Each 'task' is a YAML file with an example user prompt, metadata, and multiple judges: LLM judges for correctness and 'interestingness', plus a rule-based judge (e.g. must finish within 6 tool calls). ~200 tasks form an eval suite run nightly, with results tracked per candidate model.
takeaways.numbers: ~200 tasks; candidate 73% vs prod 72% on nightly suite

takeaways.technique: Human review of best and worst traces as a weekly ritual
takeaways.what_they_do: Beyond automated judges, the team manually reviews traces together, explicitly because LLM judges miss behavioral nuances. They use the agent itself to summarize its own traces and turn findings into new tasks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you must use humans as a necessary judge. There are behavioral nuances that LLM will not catch

takeaways.technique: Long-running work offloaded to a launch queue, agent polls
takeaways.what_they_do: Heavy jobs (days-long training) are submitted to a queue backed by external compute; the agent harness submits, then polls for completion instead of holding a live session. This decouples agent turns from long execution.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it started the cues and now it is simply polling and waiting for our work to be complete

takeaways.technique: Domain primitives + business data over harness cleverness
takeaways.what_they_do: They deliberately avoid over-engineering memory and harness tricks, and instead get gains by giving the agent context about the business domain, available primitives, and actual data. Arya is custom-tuned/prompted to understand W&B's own chart/workspace primitives.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a lot of lowhanging fruit can be ascertained through simply giving your agent context about your business domain, the underlying uh primitives

takeaways.what_they_do: LLM judges run continuously against live traffic to flag clusters like user frustration, low-quality responses, and 'ask user' moments, which the team then fixes in the next iteration.
takeaways.evidence_quote: These are LLM judges that run live against against our live traffic

takeaways.technique: Offline improvement loop gated by eval dashboard before promotion
takeaways.what_they_do: Production traces feed an offline loop: form hypotheses, implement candidate agents, run the nightly eval suite, and make go/no-go promotion decisions from a shared dashboard — a data flywheel from prod back to prod.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we form hypotheses implement candidate agents and analyze the evals
